references.text: The institution of the Feast of Tabernacles as one of the three major festivals to be celebrated each year.
A parallel command to keep a feast for the Lord for seven days in the seventh month.
The Feast of Tabernacles shall be kept for seven days as a permanent statute for all generations.
The introduction to the Feast of Tabernacles, which begins on the fifteenth day of the seventh month.
The people celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after returning from exile, as prescribed.
Solomon kept the feast for seven days together with all Israel.
The Feast of Tabernacles was celebrated after the return from Babylon as prescribed.
Jesus went up to Jerusalem during the Feast of Tabernacles, which was a Jewish festival.
The prophecy that all nations will come to Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles in the future.
